items.headline: Iranian President Addresses UN Assembly as U.S.-Iran Sideline Talks Resume
items.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the United Nations General Assembly, issuing a sharp critique of U.S. and Israeli military actions in the Middle East. The address coincides with high-stakes diplomatic talks held between U.S. and Iranian officials on the sidelines of the summit aimed at negotiating conditions to de-escalate hostilities and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline: AI Leaders Urge UN Security Council to Establish Global Controls on Artificial Intelligence
items.summary: Top executive leaders from major artificial intelligence firms testified before the United Nations Security Council on Wednesday to address rising safety risks associated with rapidly advancing technology. They called on world leaders to establish international safeguards and regulatory frameworks to ensure advanced AI systems remain under human control.

items.headline: Captains Reveal Opening Match Pairings for 2026 Presidents Cup
items.summary: Team captains Brandt Snedeker and Geoff Ogilvy announced the official opening round pairings for the 2026 Presidents Cup at Medinah Country Club on September 23. World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler will partner with Sam Burns for Team USA as competition begins Thursday against the International squad.

items.headline: Harvey Weinstein Sentenced to 15 Years in Prison at New York Retrial
items.summary: On September 23, 2026, former Hollywood producer Harvey Weinstein was sentenced by a New York judge to 15 years in prison for sexually assaulting a former television production assistant in 2006. The decision follows a 2025 retrial that was ordered after New York's highest court overturned his original 2020 conviction.
